pages.text: WorkServicesAbout UsWeb AuraBlogFAQContactGet a quoteHelp CenterQuestions, answered.Find out what we do, what a project costs and what happens after you contact us. For more about our website work, see Next.js website development. You can also explore: business websites and web development in Hyderabad. Services: services overview.Cost and scopeWhat a project involves and how it is priced.How much does a project cost?Every project is priced for the work it actually needs, so we quote after a short conversation rather than publishing a price list. What changes the cost: how many pages you need, whether you sell online or take bookings, how much of the design is custom, and what has to connect to your existing tools. Tell us what you have in mind and we send a written quote within 24 hours.How long will it take?A simple launch website or landing page takes about 2 weeks. Allow 2–4 weeks for a 5–10 page website; 4–8 weeks with an online store or custom features. Timing depends on the agreed scope, content and approvals.Are domain names, hosting and subscriptions included?Your proposal explains which setup work and outside services are included. A domain is your web address; hosting keeps your website online. Ask us to list renewal charges, paid tools and any other ongoing costs before you decide.What services can I choose from?Business Websites, Online Stores, Custom Business Software, AI & Task Automation, Google Search & SEO, Booking Systems, Business Dashboards, Branding & Design, Website Support, Digital Marketing. We can combine services when your project needs them.Getting startedWhat happens when you contact us, and what we need from you.What does WebAura do?WebAura builds websites, online stores and custom business software. We also help with branding, digital marketing, content editing from raw photos or videos, automation and ongoing support. We are based in Hyderabad and work with businesses across India and remotely overseas.Can you help a small business like mine?Yes. Tell us what your business does and what you want to improve. You may need a first website, an online shop, more enquiries or an easier way to manage daily work. You do not need to know which technology to ask for.What happens after I contact you?Get a free quote within 24 hours. For a detailed custom project, we first discuss what you need and agree the scope. You can also book a 20-minute call. We discuss your business and send a proposal explaining the work, price and next steps.What do you need from me?Tell us about your business, customers and goals. Share any existing website, logo, photos and text. We will explain what else is needed and include any agreed writing or design work in the proposal.Can you improve my existing website?Yes. Share your website address and what is not working for you. We will review whether changes to the current site or a rebuild would better suit your needs.Where is WebAura based?WebAura is based in Hyderabad, Telangana. We work with businesses across India and remotely with clients overseas.Do you work with businesses outside Hyderabad?Yes. Most of our work happens online: calls, shared documents and review links. Location does not change the price or the process.Do you work with agencies?Yes. Agencies and other partners can bring us projects for their clients. We can build under your brand when agreed. We set out responsibilities, communication, fees and support before starting.After launchSupport, ownership and keeping the site working.What support do I get after launch?We include 30 days of support after launch. Your proposal explains what is covered. Further updates, maintenance and new features can be agreed separately.Who owns the website and accounts?Your agreement identifies the code, designs and other deliverables you own. We help you keep your domain and hosting accounts under your control and explain the access you need at handover. Third-party tools keep their own terms.Can I update the website myself?If you need to edit products, photos, text or articles, tell us before we quote. We can include suitable editing tools and explain how to use them. The options depend on the website and agreed scope.Will customers find my website on Google?We set up the website so search engines can read its pages and understand your services. This includes page titles, clear content and technical checks. Search rankings depend on several factors and are not guaranteed. Ongoing SEO work can be agreed separately.Do you check website speed?Pages load in under 2 seconds, pass Core Web Vitals checks and achieve a performance score above 90. Core Web Vitals are checks of loading, response to interaction and page stability. We agree the pages and testing conditions for your project.What technology do you use?We choose tools to suit the project, budget and how your team will manage it. Our work includes React, Next.js and WordPress websites. You can explain the business need first; we will explain the options in plain language.How do you use my enquiry details?We use the details you submit to respond, understand your project and manage the enquiry. Our Privacy Policy explains the information used by the website and how to contact us about it.Website and software terms explainedPlain explanations of terms you may come across while planning a project. Learn more in our website development guide, fast website guide, Next.js & SEO article, and website costs.What is SEO?SEO means search engine optimisation. It is work on your website and content to help people find you through relevant searches. Rankings are not guaranteed.Do I need a website or a mobile app?A website is often a useful starting point when customers need to find information or contact you. An app may suit regular tasks or features that need it. Tell us how people will use it and we can discuss the options.What is a dashboard?A dashboard brings selected information into one screen, such as enquiries, orders or sales. We agree which records and reports you need.What is business automation?It means using software to handle repetitive tasks, such as sending a booking reminder or passing an enquiry to the right person. We agree which tasks can run automatically.What does SaaS mean?SaaS means software as a service: software customers use online, often through a subscription. We can discuss building a product that your business offers to its own customers.Before you start a projectQuestions to help you understand a proposal, prepare for the work and plan the handover.What should I check in a website quote?Every project is priced for the work it actually needs, so we quote after a short conversation rather than publishing a price list. What changes the cost: how many pages you need, whether you sell online or take bookings, how much of the design is custom, and what has to connect to your existing tools. Tell us what you have in mind and we send a written quote within 24 hours. Which pages and features are included? Who supplies the text, photos and product information? What renewals, subscriptions or maintenance costs are separate? We explain the agreed scope in your proposal.What helps a project stay on schedule?A simple launch website or landing page takes about 2 weeks. Allow 2–4 weeks for a 5–10 page website; 4–8 weeks with an online store or custom features. Timing depends on the agreed scope, content and approvals. Provide the agreed content and account access. Review designs and answer questions at the agreed stages. Discuss extra features before adding them. We explain dependencies before work begins.What should I expect at handover?We include 30 days of support after launch. Your proposal explains what is covered. Further updates, maintenance and new features can be agreed separately. Access to the accounts and deliverables agreed in your contract. An explanation of the editing tools included in your project. A clear way to request support and future changes. Ask us to include your handover needs in the proposal.Still deciding?Tell us what you need help with.Share your business and what you want to improve. We will explain the options and next steps.Contact Web AuraExplore servicesWEBAURAHYDERABAD.Websites, software and marketing for your business.
